issues: p4 Kadıköy-Karaköy-Eminönü: all three columns are 'departure'. Rows are read as one boat circuit Kadıköy→Karaköy→Eminönü→Kadıköy (Karaköy≈Kadıköy+20-25, Eminönü≈Karaköy+10); final return Kadıköy stop added without time. There is no separate return table — Eminönü departures are the Eminönü→Kadıköy leg.
p4: early rows 06:10*/06:35* and 06:30**/06:55** have Eminönü '-': modelled as Kadıköy→Karaköy→Kadıköy loops (trip lists Kadıköy twice).

p4: from 21:00 on, Kadıköy and Karaköy columns show identical times and Eminönü '-': these cannot be the same boat, so modelled as independent direct Kadıköy→Karaköy and Karaköy→Kadıköy departures (21:00..01:00, after midnight as 24:00/24:30/25:00).
p4: 20:55*** Karaköy (no boarding) belongs to the 20:30 Kadıköy row, continuing to Eminönü 21:05 → marked no_board on Karaköy.

p5 Üsküdar-Karaköy-Eminönü: same circuit interpretation (Üsküdar→[Karaköy]→Eminönü→Üsküdar); rows with Karaköy '-' go Üsküdar→Eminönü direct. Return Üsküdar stop has no time. Evening rows (e.g. Üsküdar 22:00 / Eminönü 22:30) have a 30-min gap, so the Eminönü departure may be a separate boat; model still valid for connections.

p6 night Kadıköy-Karaköy-Beşiktaş: Beşiktaş column is labelled departure; rows read as circuit Kadıköy→[Karaköy]→Beşiktaş→Kadıköy (return leg stop at Karaköy unknown, not included). Kadıköy pier differs per row (Old * / New **), stored in note.
p6 Kadıköy-Beşiktaş and p7 Kadıköy-Kabataş: independent departure lists per terminal → two-stop trips without destination time; no duration stated on page.
p9: Üsküdar 08:15* is an arrival time (footnote) and Kadıköy is '-': trip Ortaköy 08:05 → Üsküdar arr 08:15, terminates at Üsküdar.
